title: Structural coherence of a normalized ringed tensor comparison
statement: Let two small ringed sites with independent universes, their module-sheaf categories, and their derived categories be as in [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let U be additive exact, preserving the products and K-injective complexes required to form its derived functor. Give U the coherent underived tensor and Hom comparisons of [def-sf-ringed-forget-tensor-transposition-data]. Fix closed tensor presentations, K-flat tensor representative models, and their signed structural coherence on both derived categories as in [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model, lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal]. Suppose termwise U preserves flat-term K-flat complexes. GIVE a natural total-tensor chain isomorphism whose value on every coproduct summand is the specified underived tensor isomorphism, and GIVE a derived tensor natural isomorphism satisfying the representative square on every flat-term K-flat pair. Then this given derived isomorphism has unit, associator and symmetry coherence; its unit comparison is normalized by the image of the source unit-model isomorphism, the exact-functor localization factor, the single-complex comparison and the degree-zero image of the underived unit comparison, followed by the inverse target unit-model isomorphism. No existence or uniqueness of either given tensor isomorphism is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0FPT (lemma-symmetric-monoidal-derived), with Tags 06YS, 06YU and 0G7D; structural coherence step 4 of lem-sf-ringed-forget-tensor-descent.

proof.text: Construct ringedForgetTensorUnitIso as a composite of the image of the source unit model, the exact-functor factor, the single-complex comparison, the image of the underived unit isomorphism, and the inverse target unit model. All factors are actual isomorphisms. Cancellation of the last factor proves precisely the required unit-normalization equality.

Apply the three representative lemmas: associativity at triples of flat-term K-flat complexes, both unit squares at a single such complex for the constructed unit, and symmetry at a pair. These are separate local constraints; no representative lemma asserts coherence on arbitrary derived objects.

For every derived object X, resolve a complex preimage by a flat-term K-flat complex P and compose the localized resolving quasi-isomorphism with the localization preimage isomorphism. This gives Q(P) isomorphic to X. The given resolutions construct these representatives; no arbitrary data are chosen from an unproved existence statement.

Transport each of the four equations along the resolving isomorphisms. For associativity, form the two natural transformations from F applied to the left-associated tensor to the right-associated tensor of the F-images. Their naturality conjugates equality along the triple product of the resolving isomorphisms; cancel its image. For the unit equations cancel F applied to 1 tensor e or e tensor 1, and use naturality of mu and the unitors. For symmetry cancel F applied to e tensor e', and use naturality of mu and both braidings. Package the resulting equations and explicit unit in TensorCoherence.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0FPT with 06YU; explicit unit construction and transport of the four independently stated representative constraints by naturality and K-flat resolutions.

theorem ringed_forget_tensor_coherence
    (hU : ∀ P : CochainComplex (RingedTensorModules.{c, v, r} J R) ℤ,
      P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients →
      (∀ p : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{c, v, max c v r, max c v r}
        (R := R) (P.X p)) →
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := R')
        ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ∧
      ∀ p : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{d, vd, max d vd s, max d vd s}
        (R := R') (U.obj (P.X p)))
    (chain : coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R ⋙ U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
      ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod (U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))) ⋙
        coefficientTotalTensor.{s, d, vd} J' R')
    (summand : ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (RingedTensorModules.{c, v, r} J R) ℤ)
      (p q n : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = n),
      U.map (tensorSummand.{c, v, r} J R P Q p q n hpq) ≫ (chain.hom.app (P, Q)).f n =
        u.tensor.hom.app (P.X p, Q.X q) ≫
          tensorSummand.{d, vd, s} J' R' ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
            ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) p q n hpq)
    (μ : SB.tensor ⋙ U.mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (U.mapDerivedCategory.prod U.mapDerivedCategory) ⋙ SA.tensor)
    (hμ : RepresentativeModel.{c, v, r, d, vd, s, wb, wa}
      J R J' R' U SB TB SA TA chain μ.hom) :
    ∃ c : TensorCoherence SB.monoidal SA.monoidal βB βA U.mapDerivedCategory μ,
      c.unit.hom ≫ cA.unitIso.hom =
        U.mapDerivedCategory.map cB.unitIso.hom ≫
          U.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app (ringedTensorUnitComplex.{c, v, r} J R) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map
            ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex U (.up ℤ) 0).hom.app
              (SheafOfModules.unit ((sheafCompose J
                (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R))) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map
            ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) (0 : ℤ)).map (u.coherence.unit).hom)
